sources.join_method: Unicode NFKC + casefold + URL decode + underscore-to-space + whitespace collapse

interpretation: This is title-join coverage only. The source records only top-ranked pages; an absent article-day is unknown/censored, not zero views. Title matching does not guarantee historical text exists before the target. For a daily target on date D, a text revision dated before D is considered available at the prior-day cutoff; same-day revisions are ambiguous and pages with no earlier revision have no time-safe semantic text for this observation.
